format: Rows of streamed Markdown's top-level blocks in a scrollback surface. Core (renderer.scrollback-surface.test.ts) and Rust (tests/split.rs) run this file. A row is [name, chunks, width, committed, rows].

The document streams in its chunks into a Markdown that fills a surface `width` columns wide, and the surface renders after the last chunk. committed is the committed block count. rows holds [start, end) for each top-level block in order: Core's children's y and y + height, Rust's Markdown::block_rows, in the rows ScrollbackSurface commits.
rows: a wrapped paragraph, a heading, code and a list before a streamed tail
